headline: Senate powers through health bills and positions for Wednesday showdown on African trade and CDC chief!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed three major health measures: S. 4472 to reauthorize the Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Act through fiscal year 2031, and S. 494 establishing a national plan to coordinate epilepsy research. The chamber also recognized the 80th anniversary of the Fulbright Program. Meantime, the Senate continued debate on H.R. 6500, the AGOA Extension Act, with a cloture vote scheduled for Wednesday morning.
